properties.rationale: Accepted and deliberate, re-recorded because adding cmp:skills changed the shape and expired the previous acceptance. ifc:mcp-tools IS reflow2's single front door: one MCP surface over one core is the architecture (dec:one-surface), and "add redundancy" would mean a second way to reach the same graph — more surface, more drift, no benefit. The honest mitigation already exists: the degraded server means losing that door tells you why rather than looking like reflow2 was never installed.
